## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
A.(Basic Operation)
A1
```{r}
v<-seq(5, 50, by=5)
print(v)
print(length(v))
print(sum(v))
print(mean(v))

```
A2
```{r}
v<-rep(c(1,2,3), times=4)
z<-rep(c(1,2,3), each=4)

print(v)
print(z)
```
A3
```{r}
print(17%%5)
print(17%/%5)
print(2^10)
print(sqrt(144))
print(round(pi,3))
```
A4
```{r}
a<-c(2,4,6)
b<-c(3,5,7)

print(a+b)
print(a*b)
print(a>b)
print(sum(a*b))
```
A5
```{r}
students <- paste("Student-",1:3,sep="")

print(students)

print(typeof(42))
print(typeof(42L))
print(typeof("42"))
print(typeof(4i))
print(typeof(TRUE))
```
B.(Data Frames and Conditional Statement)
B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana",
           "Eli", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(students)
```
B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```
B3
```{r}
students$average <- round(
  rowMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")]),
  1
)

print(students)
```
B4
```{r}
students$passed <- students$average >= 70 &
                   students$attendance >= 75

print(students)
```
B5
```{r}
students$standing <- ifelse(
  students$average >= 90, "Honors",
  ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support")
)

print(students)
```
B6
```{r}
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    "Distinction"
  } else if (score >= 70){
    "Merit"
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    "Pass"
  } else {
    "Fail"
  }
}
print(sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify))
```
C.(rbind() and cbind())
C1
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

new_students$average <- round(
  rowMeans(new_students[, c("midterm", "final")]),
  1
)

new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 &
                       new_students$attendance >= 75

new_students$standing <- ifelse(
  new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
  ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support")
)

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)

print(students_all)
print(class(students_all))
```
C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)

students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)

print(students_all)
print(class(students_all))
```
C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
print(m)
```
C4
```{r}
bad <- data.frame(id = 11, nm = "Zed")
tryCatch(rbind(students, bad),
         error = function(e) {message("rbind failed:", conditionMessage(e)); NULL})
```
